description: This Java class 'NetStringUtil' provides utility functions for converting strings between different encodings and formats, including normalization and case conversion, primarily for use within Chromium's networking code on Android.

classes.name: NetStringUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for string encoding conversions, normalization, and case transformation for network-related string processing.

methods.name: convertToUnicode
methods.description: Converts ByteBuffer text from specified charset to Unicode string; returns null on failure.

methods.name: convertToUnicodeAndNormalize
methods.description: Converts ByteBuffer text to Unicode and normalizes it to NFC form; returns null on failure.

methods.name: convertToUnicodeWithSubstitutions
methods.description: Converts ByteBuffer text to Unicode, replacing invalid characters with U+FFFD; returns null on failure.

methods.name: toUpperCase
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase using the default locale; returns null on failure.
